title: Forward Deployed Engineer, FDE (L4)
text:
CSQ227R29

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data. 

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The impact you will have:

Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration

Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer

Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.

Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.

Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.

Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.

Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.

Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What we look for:

9+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering

Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks

Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one

Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals

Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments

Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs

Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.

Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.

Documentation and white-boarding skills.

Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range

Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.

Travel to customers 20% of the time

title: Software Development Test Engineer I
location: Bangalore HQ · Chennai Regional Office · OnSite
text:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

About the Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET-I) to join our Engineering team. As an SDET-I, you will contribute to building and enhancing test automation across our cloud-native applications, working alongside experienced engineers to strengthen quality engineering practices and support continuous delivery.

You will collaborate with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and DevOps teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle. This role requires solid programming fundamentals, a keen interest in automation, and a willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced engineering environment.



Key Responsibilities

 - Develop and maintain automated test scripts for UI, API, and integration testing using established frameworks.

 - Write reliable automated test cases using Java and automation tools such as Playwright.

 - Build and execute API test suites using Rest Assured or equivalent frameworks.

 - Contribute to the integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing.

 - Collaborate with developers and senior SDETs to understand features, improve testability, and ensure product quality.

 - Review functional and technical requirements, identify test scenarios, and create detailed test plans.

 - Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing across distributed applications.

 - Debug test failures, investigate root causes, and work with development teams to resolve defects.

 - Improve and expand test automation coverage and execution reliability.

 - Participate in sprint ceremonies, backlog grooming, and engineering discussions.

 - Follow and adopt engineering best practices, coding standards, and team conventions.



Required Qualifications

 - Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.

 - 1.5years – 3 years of experience in Software Development in Test or QA Automation.

 - Solid programming skills in Java with a good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming principles.

 - Working experience with Playwright or Selenium WebDriver.

 - Hands-on experience in API testing using Rest Assured, Postman, or similar tools.

 - Familiarity with test frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent.

 - Basic understanding of software engineering principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies.

 - Exposure to CI/CD concepts and tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.

 - Good debugging and analytical skills.

 - Experience using Git for version control and collaborative workflows.



Preferred Qualifications

 - Exposure to microservices architecture and API-first development patterns.

 - Basic familiarity with Docker and containerized environments.

 - Awareness of cloud platforms such as AWS.

 - Basic knowledge of relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and writing SQL queries.

 - Familiarity with messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.

 - Interest in observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Kibana.

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and share. The team is small, agent-first and sits apart from the main org, with very fast CI, so ideas often ship the same or next day. Today, one engineer runs the whole iOS app alone.

We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer to own ElevenMusic across iOS and Android, and to make mobile a driver of the product rather than a downstream port of web features. You’ll build for musicians and creatives, think in systems as well as screens, and work with high autonomy and a high bar for taste.

Requirements

 - Shipped a well-designed, production mobile app that real users love, and can show us what you owned.

 - Strong systems thinking across mobile and backend. We’re framework-agnostic (Swift UI or Kotlin Jetpack Compose), but expect you to work across iOS and Android.

 - Exceptional product taste and a clear view on what makes a mobile experience great.

 - Highly self-directed: you turn loose directions into shipped work and own the outcome.

Bonus: musical interest or intuition. Open-source or GitHub contributions.

title: R&D Engineer (C++)
text:
Company Description
Ubisoft is a global leader in gaming with teams across the world creating original and memorable gaming experiences, from Assassin’s Creed, Rainbow Six to Just Dance and more. We believe diverse perspectives help both players and teams thrive. If you’re passionate about innovation and pushing entertainment boundaries, join our journey and help us create the unknown!
Job Description
Job Purpose:
The R&D Engineer designs and owns automation artifacts at source-code and framework level, enabling scalable and reliable automated testing. The role ensures automation systems remain stable, usable, and aligned with evolving project and product requirements.
IMPACT :
• Design and implement automation components and systems, owning system-level outcomes across implementation and stability.

• Translate QA/QC needs into scalable source-code-level automation solutions.

• Own automation components end-to-end from design to maintenance.

• Diagnose failures driven by engine behavior, timing, or integration gaps.

• Build systems improving execution reliability, diagnostics, and maintainability.

• Ensure components are reusable, documented, and aligned to QE usage.

• Handle complex automation challenges independently, making implementation decisions within defined architectural boundaries.
INNOVATION: 
• Strengthen the automation ecosystem by building and enhancing features of the automation framework.

• Solve component-level automation challenges across game engines.

• Deliver reusable automation components reducing automation complexity and increasing scalability.

• Define improvements to automation systems based on system-level learnings and implementation experience.

• Translate experimentation outcomes into reusable and scalable solutions across projects.
KNOWLEDGE :
CORE COMPETENCIES

• End-to-end ownership of engineering outputs.

• High-quality technical documentation and system clarity.

• Supporting junior engineers through code reviews and feedback.

• Analytical problem-solving with scalable solution design and sound technical judgment.

• Technical mentorship and knowledge sharing with junior engineers and interns.

• Ownership of delivery quality aligned with engineering and QC standards.

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES

• Strong C++ with C#/Python usage.

• CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/TeamCity).

• Hands-on experience on game automation framework

• Engine integration and deep debugging.

• Version control best practices and code reviews.

BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

• Communicates technical decisions clearly with stakeholders across automation, product, FQC, and co-dev teams.

• Collaborates proactively to align game design updates and ensure smooth feature and automation integrations.

• Shows strong initiative in exploring tools, frameworks, and optimization techniques to improve engineering outcomes.

• Approaches complex problems analytically and proposes practical, scalable solutions.
Qualifications
Seniority:

5-8 years development including 2–3 years tools/automation for QC;

BE/BTech/MTech/MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, or a related technical field. Equivalent demonstrated professional experience will be considered.
